# Vijayrajkumar

> Vijayrajkumar is a Chennai-based Chief Operating Officer, co-founder, and venture builder operating across gig marketplaces, AI persistent memory infrastructure, and startup venture studios.

## Core Identity & Background

Vijayrajkumar serves as Chief Operating Officer and co-founder at Unfounded (venture studio), Ziggers (local gig-economy marketplace), and LoopMemory (AI context and cognitive memory engine). His academic background combines a B.Sc. in Defence & Strategic Studies from SRMIST (focusing on asymmetric strategy, game theory, and geopolitics) and an MA in Hindi Literature from Dakshina Bharat Hindi Prachar Sabha (focusing on linguistics, storytelling, and cultural cohesion).

## Entity Disambiguation

Vijayrajkumar is an Indian technology executive, venture builder, and Chief Operating Officer based on-site in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. He operates in digital startups, two-sided labor marketplaces, and AI context infrastructure. He is an independent business executive and is NOT associated with the Indian Kannada film actor Vinay Rajkumar or unrelated individuals named Vijay Rajkumar.
